title: Multi-session arc boundaries (06b-C)
description:
# Multi-session arc boundaries

The current single-arc placeholder (`CAMPAIGN_ARC_ID = 'arc-1'` in
`packages/cli/src/play.ts`) collapses every closed session recap in a campaign
into one `arc_summary` row. That was always a placeholder for real memory-tier
compression; as a campaign grows past a handful of sessions, the recap-list
input to arc summarization, bible extraction, and context assembly grows
unbounded, which is exactly what the memory pyramid is supposed to prevent.

## Goal

Introduce a mechanical multi-arc lifecycle inside `@loreweaver/core` so that
long campaigns produce a bounded, ordered sequence of compressed arc summaries
instead of one ever-growing arc-1. The DM model's context size stays bounded;
active narrative is protected by a K-recap overlap window (no-forget on the
last K closed session recaps verbatim, regardless of arc boundary); long-tail
historical detail is recoverable through the existing `memory_drilldown`
selector for `{ target: 'arc' }`.

## User-visible outcome

There is no player-facing surface change. Players do not see, declare, or
manage arcs. The effect is internal: the DM context at the start of any turn
contains a bounded prefix (bible + closed arc summaries + K most-recent recaps
+ current scene log) regardless of campaign length.

## Scope

- New `campaign_arc` lifecycle table + `arc_id` column on `campaign_session`.
- New core module `packages/core/src/memory/campaignArc.ts` owning the
  lifecycle functions (open / get / stamp / close-and-open-next).
- Mechanical, count-based rollover at session-close time (default N=5).
- ContextAssembler auto-discovers all closed arc summaries and inlines a
  K-recap overlap window (default K=5).
- Schema bump (v7 → v8) following the project's existing
  bump-and-refuse-old-DBs convention; no data migration code.

## Non-goals

- Any player-facing arc command, prompt, or display.
- Bible-input or bible-faithfulness changes — owned by the sibling epic
  "Strengthen campaign bible faithfulness," independently scheduled.
- Model-inferred boundary heuristics (e.g., asking the summarizer "did this
  session close an arc?"). Mechanical only in v1.
- Per-arc campaign bible. Bible stays per-campaign.
- Token-budget cadence. Count-based only in v1; can be added later if real
  campaigns reveal recap-size drift.
- Backwards compatibility on `arcId` fields of `ContextAssemblyInput` and
  `OrchestrateTurnInput`. Both live on `@loreweaver/core/internal`; per
  `AGENTS.md` the internal subpath has no compatibility promise.

## Parent

`loreweaver-06b` (`Upgrade arc rollup and campaign bible to authored content`)
was decomposed into three children; this is 06b-C, the multi-session boundary
piece. 06b-A and 06b-B are already shipped.
design:
# Design

## Constants

- **N — `arcRolloverThreshold`** (default 5). When the open arc accumulates N
  closed sessions, the next session-close triggers rollover.
- **K — `recapWindowSize`** (default 5). Number of most-recent closed session
  recaps inlined verbatim in every assembled context, regardless of which arc
  they belong to. K is the system's no-forget-on-active-narrative guarantee.

Both live on a new `MemoryConfig` interface on `PlayDeps` and are not exposed
to players.

## Schema additions

```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaign_arc (
  campaign_id  TEXT NOT NULL,
  arc_id       TEXT NOT NULL,         -- 'arc-1', 'arc-2', ...
  sequence_no  INTEGER NOT NULL,      -- 1, 2, 3, ... for ordering
  status       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('open', 'closed')),
  opened_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
  closed_at    TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, arc_id)
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS campaign_arc_one_open
  ON campaign_arc(campaign_id) WHERE status = 'open';

ALTER TABLE campaign_session ADD COLUMN arc_id TEXT;   -- nullable for grandfathered rows
```

This mirrors the existing `campaign_session` / `scene` lifecycle convention
(status enum + partial unique index enforcing one-open-per-scope).

Existing `arc_summary` table is unchanged: a row is written when an arc
**closes**. Open arcs have no `arc_summary` row.

## New core module — `packages/core/src/memory/campaignArc.ts`

Pure DB-side lifecycle module (no model calls). Exports:

- `openArcIfMissing(db, { campaignId, now }) → { arcId, sequenceNo }`
  Idempotent. Creates the next arc row if no open arc exists; returns the
  open arc otherwise. Initial call on a fresh campaign creates `arc-1`.
- `getOpenArc(db, { campaignId }) → { arcId, sequenceNo } | undefined`
- `getClosedArcCount(db, { campaignId }) → number`
- `getClosedSessionsInOpenArc(db, { campaignId }) → CampaignSessionRow[]`
  Sessions with `status='closed'` and `arc_id` = open arc, ordered by
  `closed_at`.
- `stampSessionWithOpenArc(db, { campaignId, sessionId })`
  Sets `campaign_session.arc_id` to the open arc. Asserts an open arc
  exists. Intended to run inside the existing graceful-close transaction.
- `closeOpenArcAndOpenNext(db, { campaignId, arcId, summary, sourceSessionIds, campaignBible, now }) → { closedArcId, newArcId }`
  Single transaction: writes `arc_summary`, sets `campaign_arc.status='closed'`
  + `closed_at`, inserts new `campaign_arc` row with `status='open'` and
  `sequence_no+1`.
- `listClosedArcSummaries(db, { campaignId }) → ArcSummaryRecord[]`
  Ordered by `sequence_no` (joins `arc_summary` against `campaign_arc`).

## Session-close integration

Replaces `rollupCampaignArc` in `packages/cli/src/play.ts`:

1. Existing path: close session and write recap (already atomic).
2. `openArcIfMissing(db, { campaignId, now })` — lazy on first call.
3. `stampSessionWithOpenArc(db, { campaignId, sessionId })`.
4. `getClosedSessionsInOpenArc(...)`. If count `< arcRolloverThreshold`,
   return.
5. Build recap list for sessions in step 4. Call existing
   `extractBibleWithRetry(deps.model, { campaignId, recaps })` and
   `composeArcSummary(deps.model, { campaignId, arcId, recaps, bible })`.
6. On either model call throwing: log a warning, return. Open arc stays
   open. The arc temporarily has more than N sessions; this is harmless and
   the next session-close retries the full rollover.
7. On success: `closeOpenArcAndOpenNext(...)`.

This preserves today's "atomic skip on model failure" behavior end-to-end:
the session is still fully closed and recapped on the unhappy path, only the
arc tier is deferred.

### CLI messaging

- On rollover skip below threshold (count `< N`): silent (no output;
  matches today's "no recaps → return" behavior).
- On rollover skip due to model failure: keep the existing
  `Arc rollup skipped (bible extraction failed): ...` /
  `Arc rollup skipped (arc summary failed): ...` messages verbatim. No
  regression in operator visibility.
- On successful rollover: one new line, e.g.
  `Arc {closedArcId} closed; opened {newArcId}.` Brief, factual, single
  line per close at most.

## Context-assembly changes — `packages/core/src/orchestrator/contextAssembler.ts`

- Remove `arcId?: string` from `ContextAssemblyInput`.
- Remove `arcSummary: ArcSummaryRecord | undefined` from `AssembledContext`;
  replace with `arcSummaries: ArcSummaryRecord[]` ordered by `sequence_no`.
- Default for `recentSessionLimit` raises from `1` to `5` (K).
- Inside `assembleContext`: replace the single `getArcSummary` lookup with
  `listClosedArcSummaries(db, { campaignId })`; recap list is the K
  most-recent `session_recap` rows in the campaign by `created_at desc`,
  reversed to chronological order.
- `omittedSessionCount` keeps its meaning: number of `session_recap` rows
  excluded from the window.

## Orchestrator changes — `packages/core/src/orchestrator/orchestrator.ts`

- Remove `arcId?: string` from `OrchestrateTurnInput`. No callers in the CLI
  pass it today; the field is dead weight after the contextAssembler change.

## Schema versioning (no data migration)

The project's schema convention is "bump `SCHEMA_VERSION` + refuse to load
older DBs" — see `assertSchemaCompatible` in
`packages/core/src/persistence/schema.ts`. There is no migration
infrastructure today, and prior schema changes (e.g. `campaign_rules_binding`
in commit 68e15a5) follow this pattern.

x63 follows the same convention:

- Bump `SCHEMA_VERSION` from 7 to 8.
- Add `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaign_arc (...)` plus the partial
  unique index inside the existing `initSchema` block.
- Modify the `campaign_session` `CREATE TABLE` to include `arc_id TEXT`
  from the start — fresh v8 DBs get it on creation.
- Pre-v8 databases throw `SchemaCompatibilityError` on `initSchema` per
  existing convention. Dev databases are recreated; there is no production
  user data to preserve.

No code-side data migration runs. The "grandfather pre-x63 arc-1 data" path
is unnecessary because pre-v8 DBs cannot load.

## Config plumbing

```typescript
// packages/core/src/types or similar
export interface MemoryConfig {
  arcRolloverThreshold: number;  // N — default 5
  recapWindowSize: number;       // K — default 5
}
```

`PlayDeps` gains `memoryConfig: MemoryConfig`. The play CLI populates it from
defaults; tests can override. `contextAssembler` reads `recapWindowSize` via
the existing `recentSessionLimit` field (callers pass it from config).

## File map

- `packages/core/src/persistence/schema.ts` — bump `SCHEMA_VERSION` to 8,
  add `campaign_arc` table + partial unique index, add `arc_id TEXT` column
  to `campaign_session`'s CREATE TABLE.
- `packages/core/src/memory/campaignArc.ts` — new module.
- `packages/core/src/memory/index.ts` (or internal.ts) — export lifecycle
  functions on the internal subpath only.
- `packages/core/src/orchestrator/contextAssembler.ts` — drop `arcId`, add
  `arcSummaries[]`, raise default recap window, switch to list query.
- `packages/core/src/orchestrator/orchestrator.ts` — drop `arcId`.
- `packages/cli/src/play.ts` — replace `rollupCampaignArc`; remove
  `CAMPAIGN_ARC_ID` constant; thread `memoryConfig` through deps.
- `packages/cli/src/play.ts` — `closeInput` and adjacent helpers updated
  where they used the single-arc constant.
- Tests as listed below.

## Testing strategy

Unit (`packages/core/test/campaignArc.test.ts`, new):
- `openArcIfMissing` creates arc-1 on first call; second call is a no-op and
  returns the same id.
- `stampSessionWithOpenArc` updates `campaign_session.arc_id`; throws if no
  open arc.
- `closeOpenArcAndOpenNext` is atomic: writes `arc_summary`, flips status,
  inserts next arc — all-or-nothing.
- `listClosedArcSummaries` returns rows ordered by `sequence_no`.

Schema tests:
- Fresh DB has `campaign_arc` table and `campaign_session.arc_id` column.
- `SCHEMA_VERSION` is 8.
- A v7 database raises `SchemaCompatibilityError` on `initSchema` (existing
  guard; just confirm it still works at the bumped version).

Integration (`packages/cli/test/play.test.ts`, extend):
- Closing the Nth session triggers rollover: `arc-1` closed, `arc-2` opened,
  `arc_summary` row for `arc-1` present.
- Closing the (N+1)th session does NOT re-roll (arc-2 still open).
- Closing 2*N sessions yields two closed arcs and an open third arc; both
  `arc_summary` rows present with disjoint `source_session_ids`.
- Rollover model failure (compose throws) leaves the open arc intact (no
  status flip, no `arc_summary` write); next session-close retries.
- **K-recap window spans arc boundary** (the no-forget guarantee): with
  N=5 / K=5, after the Nth session triggers rollover and arc-2 opens, the
  next assembled context contains `arc-1`'s summary AND the 5 most-recent
  session recaps (which are exactly the 5 sessions of arc-1, since arc-2
  has none yet). The recap-window does not "snap" to the new arc; it
  slides forward by session, independent of arc boundaries.

ContextAssembler (`packages/core/test/contextAssembler.test.ts`, extend):
- `arcSummaries` returns all closed arcs in `sequence_no` order.
- `recapWindowSize` defaults to 5; passing a custom value via
  `recentSessionLimit` is respected; `omittedSessionCount` matches.

## Tradeoffs and risks

- **No data migration; v7 DBs require recreation.** The project's schema
  convention rejects old-version DBs on load. x63 follows that convention
  rather than building migration infrastructure. Dev DBs are recreated;
  there is no production user data to preserve.
- **Bible call still reads all recaps** (today's behavior) until the sibling
  bible epic ships. That's a known sub-optimal state during the gap — input
  to bible extraction is not bounded by arc cadence yet, but x63's arc tier
  output is. The two epics together close the loop.
- **Open arc may exceed N if rollover keeps failing.** Accepted. The
  rollover idempotently retries on the next successful close, eventually
  producing a single arc summary that covers more than N sessions.
- **`recentSessionLimit` semantic shift.** Default goes from 1 to 5. Any
  internal-subpath caller relying on the old default will see a larger
  context. That's acceptable per the internal-subpath compatibility policy.
acceptance_criteria:
## Acceptance criteria

- A 30-session campaign with default config (N=5, K=5) produces six closed
  arc summaries (`arc-1` through `arc-6`, all `status='closed'` in
  `campaign_arc` with matching `arc_summary` rows) and exactly one open
  arc (`arc-7`).
- At any turn, `assembleContext` returns: `campaignBible`, all closed
  `arcSummaries` ordered by `sequence_no`, the K=5 most-recent
  `session_recap` rows in chronological order, the current scene's
  transcript, and the player input.
- `arcId` is no longer present on `ContextAssemblyInput` or
  `OrchestrateTurnInput`.
- Model failure during rollover leaves the open arc open (status still
  `'open'`, no new `arc_summary` row); the next successful session-close
  retries the rollover and completes it.
- Player-facing CLI surface is unchanged — no new commands, no new prompts,
  no arc display.
- A fresh v8 database has the `campaign_arc` table and the `arc_id` column
  on `campaign_session` from creation. Pre-v8 databases raise
  `SchemaCompatibilityError` per existing convention.

## Verification commands

- `npm run typecheck` — passes.
- `npm run test` — all non-skipped tests pass; new unit, integration, and
  migration tests are green.
- Manual: on a fresh v8 DB, `PRAGMA table_info(campaign_session)` shows
  the `arc_id` column; `SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'
  AND name='campaign_arc'` returns one row.
close_reason: Multi-arc lifecycle shipped via PR #60 (squash-merged as 4b4428c on main). All 7 original child tasks (x63.1-x63.7) completed with two-stage subagent review. A final whole-epic review surfaced 3 Important cross-cutting issues (arc-stamp atomicity, recapWindowSize plumbing, vestigial arcRollup on public surface), all addressed in commit f9e7712 and re-verified. Full gate: 439 passed / 2 skipped. CI green on PR. Two P4 follow-ups deliberately left open for future polish (closed parent intentional, matches the 06b->x63 pattern): loreweaver-x63.8 (defensive UPDATE assert + zero-arc-rows test on closeOpenArcAndOpenNext) and loreweaver-x63.9 (MemoryConfig validation + retry-after-failure integration test). Sibling epic loreweaver-06b.1 (Strengthen campaign bible faithfulness) carries the bible-side work independently.

comments.text:
Final epic review summary for `2eb2f2d..c760cd4` (loreweaver-x63):

Assessment: With fixes (one important integrity issue + one dead config knob; otherwise solid)

Quality gates: typecheck + test both green locally (53 files, 437 passed / 2 skipped — matches CI baseline).

Strengths
- Clean layered design: schema -> campaignArc lifecycle module (writes) -> contextAssembler (reads) -> play.ts (orchestration). Each layer is independently tested.
- closeOpenArcAndOpenNext is properly atomic: verify-open-arc + arc_summary write + status flip + new-arc insert in one transaction, backed by the partial unique index `campaign_arc_one_open`.
- The K-recap window correctly spans arc boundaries: selectAlwaysOnMemory orders session_recap rows by created_at DESC then reverses, independent of arc membership. Test `K-recap window spans an arc boundary` locks this in.
- listClosedArcSummaries joins on `ca.status='closed'`, so a hypothetical orphan arc_summary row for an open arc is filtered out (covered by test).
- Bible extraction is now scoped to the *open arc's* recaps rather than the unbounded all-recaps input the placeholder used. This is the load-bearing memory-pyramid win.
- Internal/root surface split respected per AGENTS.md: new campaignArc symbols live behind `@loreweaver/core/internal`, not the root export.

Critical:
- None. Happy-path data flow is sound; pre-v8 DBs raise SchemaCompatibilityError per existing convention; the epic's stated goal ("bounded DM context, K-recap overlap protects active narrative, drilldown for long-tail") is delivered.

Important:
1. `stampSessionWithOpenArc` runs AFTER `closeSessionGracefully` commits (packages/cli/src/play.ts:497-535) — the design said "intended to run inside the existing graceful-close transaction." If the process crashes between session-close commit and the stamp UPDATE, the session is permanently `arc_id=NULL`: invisible to `getClosedSessionsInOpenArc` (INNER JOIN), so it is never counted toward N and never included in any arc_summary's sourceSessionIds. Its recap still appears in the K-window verbatim until it falls off, but its long-tail compression is permanently broken with no recovery path. Fix: either thread the stamp into closeSessionGracefully's existing transaction (matches the design), or add an idempotent backfill pass at the top of rollupCampaignArcIfReady that stamps any closed session with NULL arc_id onto the current open arc.

2. `memoryConfig.recapWindowSize` is plumbed through PlayDeps but never read in production (packages/cli/src/play.ts:427-437 — runTurn is called with no `recentSessionLimit`). It works today only because DEFAULT_RECENT_SESSION_LIMIT in contextAssembler.ts also equals 5; any caller customizing K is silently ignored. Fix: pass `recentSessionLimit: deps.memoryConfig.recapWindowSize` into the runTurn input in turnLoop, plus a small integration test that observes a non-default K.

3. Vestigial `arcRollup`/`GracefulSessionArcRollup` option on the *stable* public surface (packages/core/src/sessionClose.ts:24-35, exported via index.ts:73). The single-arc inline rollup path is now dead code — the CLI multi-arc flow goes through closeOpenArcAndOpenNext. The option still exists and is still exercised by sessionClose.test.ts. A hosted/PWA consumer who passed `arcRollup` would write an arc_summary row with NO matching campaign_arc row, which the new listClosedArcSummaries join would silently drop. Either delete it (only tests consume it) or document why it persists.

4. MemoryConfig has no validation (N<=0 or non-integer values fall through). N=0 would attempt rollover with zero recaps on every close. Cheap to add a guard.

5. Test gap: no integration test for "rollover failure leaves arc open at N sessions, next session-close succeeds with N+1 recaps." All failure tests stop at the first failed close. Adding one would lock in the documented graceful-degradation behavior.

Minor:
- "Arc arc-1 closed; opened arc-2." reads awkwardly. Cosmetic.
- closeOpenArcAndOpenNext doesn't assert `info.changes === 1` on the close UPDATE — already filed as loreweaver-x63.8.
- getClosedSessionsInOpenArc orders by `closed_at ASC` with no tie-break; same-millisecond closes are non-deterministic. Tie-break by session_id.
- rollupCampaignArcIfReady opens up to three separate write transactions per session close (openArcIfMissing, bare stamp UPDATE, closeOpenArcAndOpenNext). Wrapping in one tx would also fix issue #1.
- Skip messages format as `(reason): message.` ending in a period — double-periods when the underlying message ends in '.'. Cosmetic.

Follow-up:
- New child: stamp-inside-transaction or backfill (fixes Important #1; load-bearing for integrity).
- New child: wire memoryConfig.recapWindowSize into runTurn (Important #2; small).
- New child: decide vs document the legacy arcRollup option on closeSessionGracefully (Important #3).
- New child: add MemoryConfig validation guard (Important #4; small).
- New child: integration test for rollover-retry after N-th failure (Important #5; small).
- Existing: loreweaver-x63.8 (defensive assert + zero-arc-rows coverage) stays valid.
